embed_muppet_questions: embed a list of raw question strings using BERT and save layer-wise vector representations to numpy files
load_squad_questions: load question strings from the SQuAD training dataset JSON file
load_hotpot_questions: load question strings from a HotpotQA dataset split (train or valid)
embed_squad_embeddings: embed SQuAD questions with BERT and save the resulting vector representations
embed_hotpot_embeddings: embed HotpotQA train and valid questions with BERT and save the resulting vector representations
